Name: Iridium Statue of Blessings
Author: TacNotCat
Description:
[AI-translated] English below, Chinese version further down.

[b][size=5]Iridium Statue of Blessings[/size][/b]
The vanilla Statue of Blessings hands out a [b]random[/b] blessing every day. This
iridium-cast version lets you [b]choose[/b] — and it can later be forged into a
Perfect statue offering seven stronger blessings.

[b][size=4]Stage 1 — Iridium Statue of Blessings[/size][/b]

[b]HOW TO LEARN THE RECIPE[/b]
[list]
[*]Enter the [b]Mastery Cave[/b] and [b]shoot the central mastery pedestal with a
slingshot[/b] (any ammo works). A sound plays and a global message confirms you
learned the recipe; shooting it again just tells you that you already know it.[/*]
[*][b]Secret Note #27[/b] (Grandpa's letter) gains an extra line hinting at the
pillar, so the unlock is discoverable in normal play.[/*]
[/list][b]CRAFTING[/b]
[list]
[*][b]30 Iridium Bars + 5 Prismatic Shards + 1 vanilla Statue of Blessings[/b]
→ 1 Iridium Statue of Blessings.[/*]
[*]The statue is a 1×1 placeable big craftable, [b]indoors or outdoors[/b].[/*]
[/list][b]HOW TO USE[/b]
[list]
[*]Requires [b]Farming Mastery[/b], same as the vanilla statue.[/*]
[*][b]Right-click the statue once per day[/b] to open a Dwarf-King-style picker:
7 icons, three per row, with the blessing name and description on hover. Pick
any of the [b]seven vanilla blessings[/b] yourself — Speed, Luck, Energy, Waters,
Friendship, Fangs or the Butterfly. The vanilla statue would roll one at random.[/*]
[*]The blessing [b]lasts for the rest of the day[/b] (until you sleep). The statue
switches to its glowing frame and plays the vanilla light pillar, butterfly and
sparkle effects.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Stage 2 — Perfect Iridium Statue of Blessings[/size][/b]

[b]FORGE UPGRADE[/b]
[list]
[*]At the [b]Volcano Forge[/b], or the [b]Mini-Forge[/b] from Mining Mastery:
put the Iridium Statue of Blessings in the [b]left ingredient slot[/b] and
[b]1 Galaxy Soul[/b] in the right slot.[/*]
[*][b]Cost: 0 cinder shards[/b] — only the statue and the Galaxy Soul are consumed.[/*]
[*]The result is the Perfect Iridium Statue of Blessings. It is the final form:
trying to put it into the forge is refused with "This statue is already perfect —
it cannot be forged further."[/*]
[/list][b]SEVEN ENHANCED BLESSINGS (pick one per day)[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Blessing of Swiftness[/b] — [b]+1 Speed[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Blessing of Fortune[/b] — [b]+2 Luck[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Blessing of Vitality[/b] — [b]+20 maximum health[/b]; you are also healed
for 20 when it is applied, and the bonus health is removed (and clamped) when the
blessing ends.[/*]
[*][b]Blessing of Abundant Waters[/b] — the [b]first 6 fish[/b] you hook today are
much easier (their difficulty is halved, ×0.75 for boss/legendary fish, and the
catch-bar penalty is halved). Hovering the buff icon shows how many eased fish
remain; the buff ends after the sixth (the vanilla blessing only covers 3).[/*]
[*][b]Blessing of Kinship[/b] — [b]positive friendship gains are doubled[/b]
(talking and gifting).[/*]
[*][b]Blessing of Savage Fangs[/b] — critical hits deal [b]+50 flat bonus damage[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Blessing of the Prismatic Butterfly[/b] — one prismatic butterfly appears at
one of the seven outdoor locations, just like the vanilla blessing. Catch it for
the vanilla gold reward, [b]plus a guaranteed extra treasure[/b]: Mystery Box 60%,
Golden Mystery Box 20%, Prismatic Shard 15%, Magic Rock Candy 5%. The buff is
consumed when the butterfly is caught. It is [b]greyed out on rainy days and
festival days[/b].[/*]
[/list]The perfect statue's menu title uses a smooth prismatic gradient and its blessing
particles are prismatic, too.

[b]NOTES[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Once per day, shared with the vanilla statue[/b] — both statues use the
vanilla daily limit. After receiving a blessing from either statue, both statues
refuse you until tomorrow, and any active statue blessing (vanilla or enhanced)
also makes them refuse.[/*]
[*][b]Buff stacking[/b]: buffs with the same id never stack, and you cannot hold
two statue blessings at once; the enhanced blessings use their own ids, so they
[b]coexist with normal food/drink buffs[/b] (e.g. Speed blessing + coffee works).[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer[/b]: the crafting recipe is learned per farmer — every player who
wants it must shoot the mastery pedestal themselves. Blessings and their buff
icons are local: you only see and benefit from your own blessing (each player can
still receive one per day).[/*]
[*][b]Uninstalling[/b]: the mod only edits game data in memory and writes nothing
into your saves. For a clean removal, let any active blessing expire (sleep once)
and pick up the two custom statues first; the vanilla Statue of Blessings consumed
as crafting material is not refunded.[/*]
[/list][b]INSTALL[/b]
Unzip into your Mods folder so that you have
Mods\IridiumBlessingStatue\manifest.json (the zip already contains the
IridiumBlessingStatue\ root folder — do not rename it), then start the game
through SMAPI. Statue names, blessing names, descriptions, the forge message and
Secret Note #27 all switch automatically with your game language
(English / 简体中文).


[b]CONFIG (optional)[/b]
Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] and this mod shows up under [b]Mod Options[/b]. Everything is optional — the defaults are the values listed here:
[list]
[*][b]Enhanced blessings[/b] — Speed bonus (default +1), Luck bonus (+2), and how many fish Blessing of Abundant Waters makes easy (3). A blessing you already hold keeps its old value until it expires.[/*]
[*][b]Crafting recipe[/b] — iridium bars (default 30) and prismatic shards (default 5) for the stage-1 statue; takes effect in the crafting menu right away.[/*]
[/list]Without GMCM nothing breaks: edit [b]config.json[/b] in the mod folder instead.
[b]REQUIREMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0.0[/b] or newer (Stardew Valley 1.6.x).[/*]
[/list]
[b]COMPATIBILITY[/b]
Works alongside [b]CJB Item Spawner[/b], [b]Lookup Anything[/b] and [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] - all optional tools, none required; gameplay is unaffected if they are not installed.
[b][size=4]铱制祝福雕像（中文版）[/size][/b]
原版祝福雕像每天只能给一个[b]随机[/b]祝福；这座铱金铸造的雕像让你亲自
[b]七选一[/b]，还能进一步锻造成完美雕像，获得 7 个更强的加强祝福。

[b]一阶段 · 铱制祝福雕像[/b]
[list]
[*][b]解锁配方[/b]：进入[b]精通山洞[/b]，用[b]弹弓射中地图中央的精通之柱[/b]
  （任意弹药均可）即学会配方，命中时有音效与全局提示；已学会时再射只会提示你
  已经学会。[b]秘密纸条 #27[/b]（爷爷的信）末尾追加了一句关于石柱的线索，正常
  游玩即可发现。[/*]
[*][b]制作配方[/b]：[b]30 铱锭 + 5 五彩碎片 + 1 个原版祝福雕像[/b] = 铱制祝福
  雕像 ×1。雕像为 1×1 大件，[b]室内外均可放置[/b]。[/*]
[*][b]使用[/b]：需已获得[b]耕种精通[/b]（与原版雕像相同）；每天[b]右键[/b]雕像
  一次，弹出矮人王雕像风格的七选一轮盘（每行 3 个图标，悬停显示名称与描述），
  从速度、运气、活力、丰渔、友谊、獠牙、七彩蝴蝶 [b]7 个原版祝福[/b]中自选一个；
  祝福[b]持续到次日睡觉[/b]，雕像切换发光贴图并播放原版光柱、蝴蝶与光点特效。[/*]
[/list][b]二阶段 · 完美铱制祝福雕像[/b]
[list]
[*][b]锻造升级[/b]：在[b]火山锻造台[/b]或采矿精通奖励的[b]简易锻造台[/b]，把铱制
  祝福雕像放进[b]左槽[/b]、[b]1 个银河之魂[/b]放进右槽，[b]火山碎片消耗 0[/b]，
  即可锻造成完美铱制祝福雕像。完美雕像是最终形态，再次放入锻造台会被拒绝并提示
  「已经很完美了，无需再锻。」[/*]
[*][b]7 个加强祝福（每天自选一个）[/b]：
 
[list]
 
[*][b]极速祝福[/b]：速度 +1。
  [/*]
[*][b]天眷祝福[/b]：运气 +2。
  [/*]
[*][b]生机祝福[/b]：最大生命值 +20；施加时同步回 20 点血，结束时自动扣除并钳制。
  [/*]
[*][b]丰渔祝福[/b]：今天最先钓上的 [b]6 条[/b]鱼会容易很多（鱼难度减半，传说/Boss
    鱼 ×0.75，钓鱼条衰减减半）；悬停 buff 图标显示还剩几条，用完 6 条后祝福消失
  （原版同款祝福只有 3 条）。
  [/*]
[*][b]挚诚祝福[/b]：[b]正向好感度获得量翻倍[/b]（对话、送礼）。
  [/*]
[*][b]獠牙祝福[/b]：暴击成功时额外造成 [b]50 点固定伤害[/b]。
  [/*]
[*][b]彩蝶祝福[/b]：每天在 7 个户外地点之一生成 1 只彩虹蝴蝶（机制同原版）；捕获时
    除原版金钱奖励外，[b]必得一件额外珍宝[/b]：谜之盒 60% / 金色谜之盒 20% /
    五彩碎片 15% / 魔法糖冰棒 5%，捕获后祝福消失；[b]雨天与节日自动置灰不可选[/b]。
  [/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]完美版菜单标题为平滑五彩渐变色，赐福光点也是五彩粒子。[/*]
[/list][b]注意事项[/b]
[list]
[*][b]每天仅限一次、与原版雕像共用限制[/b]：用过任意一座祝福雕像后，当天两座雕像
  都会拒绝你；身上已有任一套祝福 buff（原版或加强版）时同样会被摇头拒绝。[/*]
[*][b]buff 互斥[/b]：同一 id 的 buff 不会叠加，也不能同时持有两个雕像祝福；加强祝福
  使用独立 id，与[b]普通食物/饮品 buff 可以共存[/b]（如速度祝福 + 咖啡）。[/*]
[*][b]多人联机[/b]：制作配方按玩家各自解锁——谁想用谁就亲自去精通山洞射一次石柱；
  祝福与 buff 图标仅自己可见、仅对自己生效（每位玩家每天仍可各自领取一次）。[/*]
[*][b]卸载[/b]：本 mod 仅在内存中改写游戏数据，不写存档，移除文件夹即卸载干净。
  建议先睡一觉让当天祝福过期、并把两座自定义雕像收回背包再删 mod；作为材料消耗的
  原版祝福雕像不会返还。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]安装[/b]：解压到 Mods 目录，使 Mods\IridiumBlessingStatue\manifest.json 存在
  即可（zip 内根目录就是 IridiumBlessingStatue\，无需改名）；雕像名、祝福名、描述、
  锻造提示与秘密纸条 #27 均随游戏语言自动切换（英文 / 简体中文）。[/*]
[*][b]需求[/b]：SMAPI 4.0.0 及以上（星露谷 1.6.x），无其他依赖。[/*]
[/list]

[b]可选配置[/b]
装 [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]（GMCM）后，本模组会出现在游戏「选项 → 模组选项」里，下面这些都能在游戏内改，默认值就是原本的数值：
[list]
[*][b]强化祝福数值[/b]（完美雕像七种祝福用）：速度加成（默认 +1）、幸运加成（默认 +2）、丰渔祝福可强化的鱼数（默认 3）。祝福描述会自动跟着变；已经挂在身上的祝福不会重算，等它过期后再次获得才用新值。[/*]
[*][b]合成配方[/b]（一阶段雕像）：铱锭（默认 30）、五彩碎片（默认 5），另需 1 个原版祝福雕像。改完在制作菜单里立刻生效。[/*]
[/list]不装 GMCM 也完全正常，直接改 mod 文件夹里的 [b]config.json[/b]（键名与上面一一对应）。

[b]兼容性[/b]
与 [b]CJB Item Spawner[/b]、[b]Lookup Anything[/b]、[b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] 可共存——均为可选工具，非必需安装。

Manifest.Name: Iridium Statue of Blessings
Manifest.Description: Adds the Iridium Statue of Blessings: craft it (30 iridium bars + 5 prismatic shards + 1 vanilla Statue of Blessings; recipe unlocked by shooting the Mastery Cave central pedestal with a slingshot), then upgrade it at a forge with a Galaxy Soul to choose one of seven enhanced blessings every day. Tunable in Generic Mod Config Menu.
